The study also examines linearizing flat spacetime together with an extra spatial dimension, and looks at how electromagnetic properties of composite particles influence their mass differences. High‑energy collisions between identical particles are analyzed using an enlarged particle framework, while a formulation allowing particles to possess complex-valued masses is presented.
